# TeaFloww

> Direct-from-origin single-estate orthodox teas harvested in Darjeeling, Assam, Kangra, and Nilgiri. Graded, cupped, and vacuum-sealed at origin in Siliguri, West Bengal, India.

## About TeaFloww & Nirva
TeaFloww is an artisanal tea brand by Nirva, headquartered in Siliguri, West Bengal at the gateway to the Darjeeling and Dooars tea regions. We partner directly with historic tea estates and small family gardens across the Himalayas to bring freshly plucked, unblended whole-leaf teas directly to tea drinkers worldwide.

## Primary Products & Collections
- [All Teas & Single Estates](https://teafloww.com/shop): Explore the full catalog of orthodox black, high-grown green, delicate white, and complex oolong teas.
- [Darjeeling First Flush](https://teafloww.com/collections/darjeeling-first-flush): Rare spring harvests plucked at dawn above 6,000 ft, featuring crisp floral and muscatel aromatics.
- [Reserve Black Teas](https://teafloww.com/collections/black-tea): Bold orthodox lots and golden-tipped flushes from Upper Assam and Darjeeling.
- [Green & White Teas](https://teafloww.com/shop?category=green-tea): Steamed and pan-fired lots rich in antioxidants, vegetal sweetness, and clean finishes.
- [Curated Gift Sets](https://teafloww.com/gifts): Tasting flights and boxed collections for ceremonies and connoisseurs.

## Discovery & Brewing Tools
- [Interactive Tea Finder](https://teafloww.com/tea-finder): A 4-step palate quiz matching elevation, caffeine preference, and flavor notes to your ideal harvest.
- [Leaf to Cup Craft Story](https://teafloww.com/leaf-to-cup): An interactive scrollytelling journey through plucking, withering, rolling, oxidation, drying, sorting, and brewing.
- [Compare Cupping Profiles](https://teafloww.com/compare): Side-by-side comparison of terroir, liquor color, caffeine level, and flavor wheels.

## Journal & Education
- [Tea Journal & Brewing Guides](https://teafloww.com/blog): In-depth articles on water temperature, steeping times, estate histories, and regional terroirs.

## Wholesale & Corporate
- [Wholesale Inquiries](https://teafloww.com/wholesale): Direct estate rates and bulk quantities for cafes, boutique hotels, and specialty retailers.
- [Contact & Origin Facility](https://teafloww.com/contact): Customer service, Siliguri origin tasting room, and visitor information.
